zh.title: 華航天合聯盟15週年 與維珍大西洋共用班號
zh.summary: 華航慶祝加入天合聯盟15週年；宣布與維珍大西洋航空共用班號
body: 中華航空在荷蘭阿姆斯特丹舉辦記者會，慶祝加入天合聯盟15週年。華航總經理陳漢銘表示，航空公司不能單打獨鬥，要透過聯盟增加旅客便利性與方便性，提高旅客黏著度，近期華航也將與維珍大西洋航空共享班號，希望透過持續對聯盟的貢獻，以及透過聯盟在全球的強大航網，能夠持續茁壯，再邁向下一個15年。
陳漢銘致詞時指出，華航加入天合聯盟已經15週年，加入後所帶來的效益是提供旅客更多服務面向，包含行李直掛、會員哩程累積、優先登機、使用各地貴賓室等。華航補充，首階段將由華航與維珍大西洋航空共掛班號，未來雙方有望發揮航網互補效益，提升台灣與英國間的航班服務，提供旅客從亞洲往返歐洲的飛航選擇。
天合聯盟執行長胡博凱表示，華航是天合聯盟在亞洲的重要夥伴，憑藉台灣優越的樞紐位置、綿密的區域航網及客貨運優勢，為聯盟串聯亞洲與全球市場扮演重要角色。天合聯盟航網目前有18個成員航空，遍及165國、960個航點，每天超過1萬3880個航班。
華航深耕歐洲市場，目前營運阿姆斯特丹、法蘭克福、倫敦、羅馬、布拉格及維也納6大航點，每週提供近30班直飛歐洲航班，為台灣直飛歐洲航點最多、航班最密集的航空公司。除自營航線外，華航亦與荷蘭皇家航空、法國航空、西班牙歐洲航空等夥伴合作，透過共用班號服務延伸串聯英國、法國、西班牙、德國及芬蘭等歐洲主要城市，另攜手德國鐵路、英國大西部鐵路及比利時國鐵空鐵聯運。
陳漢銘舉例，華航在北美有達美航空、歐洲有法航、荷航跟維珍航空等，亞洲也有大韓航空與越南航空，彼此的交好可以讓效益發揮到最大。華航將透過加入聯盟的不同面向，提升華航的能見度，要向全球各地展現出華航是台灣最優異的航空公司。

en.title: China Airlines Marks 15 Years in SkyTeam, Announces Virgin Atlantic Codeshare
en.summary: China Airlines celebrates SkyTeam 15th anniversary; Virgin Atlantic codeshare planned
body: China Airlines held a press conference in Amsterdam, Netherlands, to celebrate its 15th anniversary since joining the SkyTeam alliance. President Chen Han-ming stated that airlines cannot operate alone with limited fleet resources and must leverage alliances to enhance passenger convenience and loyalty. He announced that China Airlines will soon codeshare with Virgin Atlantic, aiming to continue contributing to the alliance and leverage its global network for the next 15 years.

Chen noted that since joining SkyTeam in 2011 — as Taiwan's first carrier to enter a global airline alliance and the 15th member of SkyTeam — China Airlines has provided passengers with benefits including through-check baggage, mileage accrual, priority boarding, and lounge access. The airline added that the initial phase will involve China Airlines placing its code on Virgin Atlantic flights, with both carriers expected to leverage complementary networks to enhance services between Taiwan and the United Kingdom, offering more options for passengers traveling between Asia and Europe.

SkyTeam CEO Patrick Roux described China Airlines as a key partner in Asia, highlighting Taiwan's strategic hub position, dense regional network, and passenger and cargo strengths as vital for connecting Asia with global markets. The SkyTeam network currently comprises 18 member airlines serving 960 destinations across 165 countries with over 13,880 daily flights.

China Airlines operates six European destinations — Amsterdam, Frankfurt, London, Rome, Prague, and Vienna — with nearly 30 weekly direct flights, making it the Taiwanese carrier with the most European destinations and highest frequency. Beyond its own routes, China Airlines codeshares with KLM Royal Dutch Airlines, Air France, and Air Europa, extending connections to major cities in the United Kingdom, France, Spain, Germany, and Finland. The carrier also partners with Deutsche Bahn, Great Western Railway, and the National Railway Company of Belgium for air-rail intermodal services.

Chen cited Delta Air Lines in North America, Air France, KLM, and Virgin Atlantic in Europe, and Korean Air and Vietnam Airlines in Asia as examples of how close cooperation maximises alliance benefits. China Airlines aims to raise its global visibility through the alliance's various facets, demonstrating that it is Taiwan's most outstanding airline.
